_description: Complete recipe for magic/ability effects. Covers projectile, cast, aura, AOE, beam, and summon variants.

base_architecture.design_philosophy: Magic effects are NOT physically accurate. They follow artistic rules, not physics. Color, shape, and timing convey the FEELING of the spell.

element_palettes._note: Reference Principles/color_palettes.json for full color values
element_palettes.fire: orange-yellow core, red outer, warm tones
element_palettes.ice: white-blue core, cyan outer, cool tones, crystalline shapes
element_palettes.lightning: white-blue core, electric blue branches, purple accents
element_palettes.holy: golden-white core, warm gold rays, soft divine glow
element_palettes.dark: deep purple core, black tendrils, green accents
element_palettes.nature: green-gold core, leaf shapes, organic movement
element_palettes.water: blue-teal core, fluid shapes, bubble accents

projectile.description: Moving spell projectile (fireball, ice shard, energy bolt)

emitter_layers.name: Core_Glow
emitter_layers.notes: Moves with projectile. Slight pulse (sine wave on size/intensity).

emitter_layers.name: Outer_Aura
emitter_layers.material_type: Additive, very soft gradient, low opacity

emitter_layers.name: Trail_Particles
emitter_layers.purpose: Small particles left behind as projectile moves
emitter_layers.notes: Creates visible trail showing projectile path

emitter_layers.name: Trail_Ribbon
emitter_layers.material_type: Additive, panning UV along ribbon (pan direction opposite to travel)
emitter_layers.color: element color, opacity fades along length

cast_charge.description: Spell charging at character's hand/staff before release

emitter_layers.name: Gathering_Particles
emitter_layers.purpose: Particles flowing TOWARD the cast point (inward)
emitter_layers.velocity: Point Attraction Force toward cast point
emitter_layers.size: 2-8 cm, shrink as they approach center
emitter_layers.notes: Key visual: particles converge inward. Sells 'charging up'.

emitter_layers.name: Core_Buildup
emitter_layers.size_over_life: start small (5 cm), grow to 20-40 cm over charge duration
emitter_layers.notes: Intensity ramps up as charge completes

emitter_layers.name: Ground_Circle
emitter_layers.purpose: Magic circle/rune on ground below caster
emitter_layers.notes: Optional but iconic for magic effects

timing.intensity_curve: slow start, accelerate, peak at release
timing.release_moment: burst of particles outward + flash at cast point

aura_buff.description: Persistent effect around character (buff, power-up, shield)

emitter_layers.name: Aura_Glow
emitter_layers.approach: Apply fresnel material to character mesh (overlay), OR spawn large soft sprites around character

emitter_layers.name: Orbiting_Particles
emitter_layers.notes: Rotate Around Point module for orbit

emitter_layers.name: Rising_Particles
emitter_layers.purpose: Particles drifting upward from character base
emitter_layers.spawn_location: Cylinder at character feet, radius = character width

aoe_ground.description: Area of effect spell on ground (healing circle, damage zone, trap)

emitter_layers.name: Ground_Ring
emitter_layers.material_type: Additive, ring texture with panning UV for energy flow

emitter_layers.name: Vertical_Particles
emitter_layers.purpose: Particles rising from within the circle area

beam.description: Sustained beam between two points (laser, healing beam, link)

emitter_layers.name: Beam_Core
emitter_layers.material_type: Additive, panning UV along beam length

emitter_layers.name: Beam_Glow
emitter_layers.color: element mid color, emissive 3-8, low opacity

emitter_layers.name: Beam_Sparks
emitter_layers.spawn_location: along beam line (use beam position data)
emitter_layers.velocity: small random, mostly perpendicular to beam

emitter_layers.name: Impact_Point
emitter_layers.purpose: Bright glow + particles where beam hits target
emitter_layers.notes: Similar to Impact Flash + element-colored sparks

key_principles.element_consistency: ALL layers of a magic effect must use the same element color palette. Never mix fire orange with ice blue in the same spell.
key_principles.anticipation_is_critical: Magic effects NEED anticipation (charge-up) before the main action. Instant magic looks cheap.
key_principles.glow_and_emissive: Magic effects rely heavily on emissive bloom. Without it they look flat and non-magical.
key_principles.non_physical_motion: Magic particles can defy gravity, orbit, converge, pulse. Use Point Attraction, Vortex, Curl Noise freely.
key_principles.layering: Minimum 3 layers for any magic effect: core glow + particles + trail/aura. More layers = more polished.
key_principles.sound_sync: Timing of VFX should sync with audio cues. Charge builds with rising audio, release with impact sound.
